result.title: RAVEN-Bench: A Paired EO-IR Video QA Benchmark for Aerial Multimodal Understanding
result.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track)
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced rapidly in image and video understanding, yet their ability to reason over paired aerial electro-optical and infrared (EO-IR) videos remains poorly understood. Such video poses a harder test than standard RGB video QA: targets are often small, evidence may appear only briefly, viewpoints change with the platform, and useful cues may appear in only one stream. We introduce RAVEN-Bench (Reasoning over Aerial Videos with EO-IR aligNment), a paired EO-IR video QA benchmark for low-altitude aerial multimodal understanding. RAVEN-Bench contains 100 temporally aligned EO-IR video pairs and 1,200 human-authored four-way multiple-choice questions, each independently audited for answer keys, modality requirements, evidence intervals, and group validity. It supports EO-only, IR-only, and paired EO+IR evaluation, and uses hierarchical capability levels and structured question groups to diagnose paired-input gain beyond the stronger unimodal condition, unimodal reliance, target consistency, and evidence-chain coherence. We evaluate frontier, open-weight, and remote-sensing MLLMs, showing that aggregate accuracy can overstate evidence-supported EO-IR reasoning. RAVEN-Bench provides controlled modality conditions and group-level diagnostics for auditing whether progress on RGB video benchmarks transfers to aerial cross-spectral understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yuhu990424/RAVEN-Bench and https://huggingface.co/datasets/TerraSenseAnalytics/RAVEN-Bench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RAVEN-Bench：由 100 对时间对齐的低空航空 EO-IR 视频与 1,200 道人工审核的四选一问题构成，支持仅 EO、仅 IR 与 EO+IR 三种条件，并以分层能力等级与结构化问题组诊断配对输入增益、单模态依赖、目标一致性与证据链连贯性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「配对输入相对更强单模态的增益」与证据区间标注，可供核查 VLM 是否真正利用视觉证据而非走旁路；但对象是航空跨光谱视频基准，未涉及 latent 状态或内部表示，联系限于评测设计层面。
